name: Concentration Curl
summary: A seated single-arm curl with the elbow braced against the inner thigh. The fixed position makes cheating hard and focuses tension on the biceps.
setup: Sit on a bench with feet wide and take a dumbbell in one hand.
Rest the back of the upper arm against the inside of your thigh with the arm hanging straight.
Place your free hand on the other thigh and lean slightly forward with a flat back.
execution: Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm braced on the thigh.
Squeeze the biceps at the top, forearm near vertical.
Lower slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.
cues: Curl up in a smooth arc
mistakes: Swinging the torso: keep the chest still and use a lighter dumbbell.
Letting the elbow slide off the thigh: reset the position so the upper arm stays fixed.
Cutting the range of motion short: lower to a nearly straight arm each rep.
Rounding the back heavily: sit tall with a flat back and tilt only from the hips.

references.title: How To Do a Concentration Curl - [THE PERFECT DB CURL]
